basic_details.short_information: Register for Job Alerts According to the official notification, WCD Haryana intends to fill 108 Female Supervisor posts on transfer/deputation basis for an initial period of one year or until direct recruitment of supervisors through Haryana Staff Selection Commission.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 30 days from the date of publication of advertisement

qualification.details: Candidates applying for WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the eligibility conditions mentioned for deputation appointments. | Applicants must have passed 10+2 from a recognized Board. Candidates should also have knowledge of Hindi up to Matric Standard.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates for the Female Supervisor post will receive pay under FPL-6 with a pay scale of ₹35,400/-.

selection_process: The detailed selection process is not separately mentioned in the notification. The application form states that applications supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.
how_to_apply: Eligible female applicants can apply for the Female Supervisor post through proper channel along with the required supporting documents.
Prepare the application form with complete details.
Submit the application through proper channel to the Director, Women and Child Development Department.
Ensure that the application reaches the department within the prescribed period.
The application should be sent to:
Director, Women and Child Development Department, Bays No. 1, 5-20, Sector-4, Panchkula, Haryana - 134112

content_sections.text: The detailed selection process is not separately mentioned in the notification. The application form states that applications supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible female applicants can apply for the Female Supervisor post through proper channel along with the required supporting documents. Prepare the application form with complete details. Attach the required supporting documents. Submit the application through proper channel to the Director, Women and Child Development Department. Ensure that the application reaches the department within the prescribed period. The application should be sent to: Director, Women and Child Development Department, Bays No. 1, 5-20, Sector-4, Panchkula, Haryana - 134112

content_sections.heading: WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Apply Offline
content_sections.text: The application mode for WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026 is offline. Interested female applicants need to submit their applications through proper channel along with required documents.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: Bio-data of the applicant. ACR/Integrity Certificate record for previous ten years. Documents related to eligibility and employment details. The notification mentions that the ACR/Integrity Certificate record for the previous ten years should be good or should not contain any remarks. Candidates should also not have any chargesheet or pending enquiry against them.

faq.question: Q1. What is WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment notification released by the Women and Child Development Department, Haryana for filling Female Supervisor posts on transfer/deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 108 Female Supervisor posts are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name in WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Female Supervisor.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed 10+2 from a recognized Board. Knowledge of Hindi up to Matric Standard is also required.

faq.answer: Female applicants holding analogous posts in Ministries, Departments, Organisations or Offices under Government of Haryana can apply through proper channel.

faq.answer: The Female Supervisor post carries FPL-6 pay scale of ₹35,400/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply for WCD Haryana Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications should reach the department within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
